label: Throne Room
subtitle: The Throne Room
heading: The Throne Room
note: Who holds power, the countdown to the next election, any vote open now, your district and party, your duties and letters, and the latest decrees.

label: Ballot Hall
subtitle: The Ballot Hall
heading: The Ballot Hall
note: The ballot paper you seal your vote with, standing for Prime Minister, the results, and the no-confidence petition.

label: Statute Book
subtitle: The Statute Book
eyebrow: The Charter, laws and the court
heading: The Statute Book
note: The laws in force, laws awaiting Royal Assent or renewal, the rulings of the High Judiciary, and the treaties.

label: The Parties
subtitle: The Parties
heading: The Parties
note: Each party's crest, leader, members and manifesto, and the Party Chamber that only its own members can see.

label: Treasury
subtitle: The Treasury
heading: The Treasury
note: The ledger, filled in from the guild bank: the Minister of the Treasury, the balance, gold in and out, and taxes.

label: Districts
subtitle: The Districts
heading: The Districts
note: The Stormwind map with your district aglow, the Regional Council, the Citizen Roll, and district transfers.

label: The Ring
subtitle: The Gladiator's Ring
heading: The Gladiator's Ring
note: Sign-up, the bracket and the Hall of Champions for the monthly duelling tournament.
